messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Do you
still have that letter I
asked you to deliver?
{07 00 00}Look, I'm sorry for asking,{01 00 00 05 00} 
and I KNOW that it's really
last-minute...
{07 14 00}But please make sure to
deliver it on time,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Kas sul on
veel see kiri, mille ma
palusin kohale viia?
{07 00 00}Vaata, vabandust, et küsin,{01 00 00 05 00} 
ja ma TEAN, et see on
viimasel hetkel...
{07 14 00}Aga palun vii see kindlasti
õigeks ajaks kohale,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So about the letter that I
wrote to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
The one I gave to you?
{07 06 00}PLEASE make sure that it's
delivered on time,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1a 00}I don't mean to sound like
a nag,{01 00 00 03 00} but it's supposed to
be a big surprise!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii et see kiri, mille ma
kirjutasin {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 00}le{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
See, mille sulle andsin?
{07 06 00}PALUN hoolitse, et see
viidaks õigeks ajaks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1a 00}Ma ei taha kõlada nagu
näägutaja,{01 00 00 03 00} aga see peaks
olema suur üllatus!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, um,{01 00 00 05 00} are you SURE that
you can deliver that letter
on time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}will be so
upset if it's late!{01 00 00 0a 00} ...{07 01 00}And I
won't be happy either!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii et, ee,{01 00 00 05 00} kas sa oled
KINDEL, et suudad kirja
õigeks ajaks viia, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}on nii
pahane, kui hilineb!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 01 00} ...Ja
mina ei ole rõõmus!
